description: This source file defines a final class ResourceDeletedStrategy that extends AbstractPolicyEventStrategy for handling ResourceDeleted events within the Eclipse Ditto policies persistence framework. It overrides applyEvent to modify a PolicyBuilder by removing a resource based on event data.

classes.name: ResourceDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPolicyEventStrategy to handle ResourceDeleted events by removing resources from a policy builder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to handle ResourceDeleted events by removing the specified resource from the PolicyBuilder.
